messages:
mike: Heads-up — targeting tonight's change window 02:00 UTC for API + runtime + console + router. Need final pin decision and deploybot wave config. Keep rollback plan ready. @tara @aj @zhen

deploy-bot: Automated schedule created: waves pending. Canary windows 1/3/6 min. Planned steps: canary -> staggered ramp -> full. ID: wb-3921. See planned params below:
```
wb-3921: { canary: 5%, ramp: [25,60,100], hold_secs: [180,180,300], check: healthcheck, error_rate, p95_latency }
```

tara: Proposal: pin API -> v1.46.0, runtime -> r-2026-03-19, console -> c-3.2.1, router kernel -> k-2.1-quantize. Also suggest setting ROUTER_KV_TTL=60 during rollout. Any objections? :eyes:

aj: No objections on pins. For safety I'd do traffic dampening: 5% (canary) -> hold 3m -> 25% -> hold 3m -> 60% -> smoke tests -> 100%. Rollback triggers: error_rate > 1% OR p95 up > 200ms OR telemetry dropout. Example deploybot command to run the ramp:
```
deploybot promote --wave wb-3921 --ramp "5,25,60,100" --holds "180,180,180" --smoke-check "api:/health, runtime:/metrics"
```

zhen: Router note: when we flip kernel variant to k-2.1-quantize, we need kv-cache warmup. Please set ROUTER_KV_TTL=60 and runtime flag `--kv-evict=lazy` for the first 20m after full ramp to avoid hot-start OOMs. Also pin router config to avoid auto-eviction during canary.

olivia: Quick console note: console change is UI + telemetry schema bumps. No DB migrations but we should disable quicksearch reindex during the 15m after full cut to reduce load on ES cluster. I'll add a flag `console.disable_reindex=true` in the deploy plan.

mike: Good. Action items: tara will pin artifacts in release manifest, aj will own deploybot ramp and watch thresholds, zhen will patch router env flags, olivia will flip reindex flag, I'll write the rollback runbook and post link. Everyone oncall?

tara: Pins updated in manifests: `api:v1.46.0`, `runtime:r-2026-03-19`, `console:c-3.2.1`, `router:k-2.1-quantize`. Release notes draft posted in docs: https://confluence.redwood/release/wb-3921 (short bullets).

deploy-bot: wb-3921 scheduled for 2026-06-18T02:00:00Z. Canary window set to 180s. Ramp steps: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%. Rollback hook configured: `deploybot rollback --to-tag last-stable` if threshold breached. Notifications to #incidents and #oncall.

aj: I'll be oncall for the window and will start the ramp. Plan to abort and roll back if any of: error_rate >1%, p95 +200ms, or user-facing 5xx >0.5%. :+1:

mike: Thanks — final check: no outstanding blockers. If anything changes, post updates here and tag `@deploy-bot abort` if we need immediate stop.
